item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Germany recorded 2,020 asylum seekers detained in the first half of 2023; as of August 2023, there were 14 pre-removal detention centres, with a combined capacity of 782 places as of September 2023.","notes":["The excerpt dates the 14-centre figure to August 2023, not September.","The 2,020 figure is for the first half of 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"At the Büren detention facility, a local support group reported that detainees had courtyard access for only one to two hours per day despite an eight-hour legal standard; psychological and medical support was described as limited, with confidentiality concerns, and three alleged cell-fire incidents occurred in 2023. One detainee was found dead in September 2023, with the cause unknown as of March 2024.","notes":["The excerpt attributes these conditions and assessments to local support-group or activist reporting.","The wording is narrowed from a general assertion that psychological and medical assistance was definitively inadequate."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0011-R05-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Judicial review was available, and the Federal Supreme Court repeatedly found detention orders unlawful in cited cases, including 2023 cases involving denial of a lawyer's opportunity to attend a hearing and insufficient reasons for the detention duration. Separately, a law firm reported that, among 2,458 represented clients detained pending removal between 2001 and October 2023, 1,283 cases (52.2%) were found unlawful, with affected clients detained for an average of 25.8 days.","notes":["The excerpt does not support attributing a 2023 Supreme Court ruling specifically to inadequate proportionality analysis.","The law-firm figures are not presented as nationally representative."]}]}
